attacks.name: Deafen
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards or Stadium cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Second Strike
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Boundary Aura
abilities.text: Apply Weakness for each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) as ×2 instead.

attacks.name: Combo Throw
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Trash Bolt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card from your hand, this attack does nothing.)

text.name: Azelf

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Azelf from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at all of your face-down Prize cards. If you do, you may choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then, choose 1 card in your hand and put it as a Prize card face down.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Willpower," it sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

text.name: Ditto

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Ditto DNA
abilities.text: As long as Ditto is your Active Pokémon, its maximum HP is the same as your opponent's Active Pokémon. Ditto can use the attacks of that Pokémon as its own. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.) If that Pokémon is no longer your opponent's Active Pokémon, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon for Ditto to copy.

text.flavor: It has the ability to reconstitute its cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Anticipation
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to Toxicroak G.

attacks.name: Deep Poison
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Galactic Switch
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move an Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon SP to another of your Pokémon. Then, put 2 damage counters on Bronzong G. This power can't be used if Bronzong G is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.name: Uxie

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.text: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Knowledge," it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Flash Bite
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Crobat G from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Toxic Fang
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Overeager
abilities.text: If Sableye is your Active Pokémon at the beginning of the game, you go first. (If each player's Active Pokémon has the Overeager Poké-Body, this power does nothing.)

attacks.name: Impersonate
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card and discard it. Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Overconfident
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Sableye, this attack's base damage is 40.

text.name: Unown G

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: GUARD
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown G is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown G and attach Unown G to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown G is attached to a Pokémon, prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: If Unown G has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 10.

text.flavor: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

attacks.name: Honcho's Command
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Stadium cards or Trainer cards that has Team Galactic's Invention in its name, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Target Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. If that Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.name: Aaron's Collection
effect: Search your discard pile for up to 2 in any combination of Pokémon SP and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Bebe's Search
effect: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Poison Structure
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have a Stadium card in play, you may use this power. Each Active Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) (excluding Pokémon SP) is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Skuntank G is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-109 SP Radar

text.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-109 SP Radar
effect: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon SP, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

text.name: Moonlight Stadium
effect: The Retreat Cost for each {Psychic} and {Darkness} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is 0.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: SP Energy
effect: SP Energy provides {Colorless} Energy. If the Pokémon SP Energy is attached to is a Pokémon SP, SP Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

text.name: Cyrus's Conspiracy
effect: Search your deck for a Supporter card, a basic Energy card, and a Trainer card that has Team Galactic's Invention in its name, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Galactic HQ
effect: Whenever any player plays any Pokémon from his or her hand to evolve his or her Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Bright Look
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Luxray GL LV.X from your hand onto your Active Luxray GL, you may switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flash Impact
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon, and don't apply Weakness and Resistance to this damage.

rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Luxray GL. Luxray GL LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain

text.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain
effect: Attach Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain to 1 of your Pokémon SP that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. When the Pokémon this card is attached to is no longer a Pokémon SP, discard this card.
As long as Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain is attached to a Pokémon, the attack cost of that Pokémon's attacks is {Colorless} less.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-103 Power Spray

text.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-103 Power Spray
effect: You may play this card during your opponent's turn when your opponent's Pokémon uses any Poké-Power. Prevent all effects of that Poké-Power. (This counts as that Pokémon using its Poké-Power.) If you have 2 or less Pokémon SP in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn

text.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn
effect: Return 1 of your Pokémon SP and all cards attached to it to your hand.

text.name: Night Maintenance
effect: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Time Crystal
abilities.text: Each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) (excluding Pokémon SP) can't use any Poké-Bodies.

attacks.name: Remove Lost
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, remove an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and put it in the Lost Zone.

rules.label: LEVEL-UP
rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Dialga G. Dialga G LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

text.name: Roseanne's Research
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Trade Off
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck. This power can't be used if Uxie is affected by a Special Condition. You can't use more than 1 Trade Off Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Zen Blade
attacks.text: Uxie can't use Zen Blade during your next turn.

rules.label: LV.X rule
rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Uxie. Uxie LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Leap Away
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Toxicroak G is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, return Toxicroak G and all cards attached to it to your hand. This power can't be used if Toxicroak G is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Poison Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
